mapper.sql: SELECT i.*, m.name AS mentor_name, m.title AS mentor_title, m.mentor_no, m.lab_id, m.research_direction, m.quota AS mentor_quota, l.name AS lab_name, l.code AS lab_code, l.total_quota AS lab_quota, s.student_no, s.name AS student_name, s.major, s.class_name, s.grade, a.intro AS application_intro, a.skills AS application_skills, a.project_experience AS application_project FROM application_intent i JOIN mentor m ON m.id = i.mentor_id JOIN lab l ON l.id = m.lab_id JOIN application a ON a.id = i.application_id JOIN student s ON s.id = i.student_id
mapper.select: WHERE i.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY i.application_id, i.sort_no
WHERE i.student_id = #{studentId} AND i.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY i.sort_no
WHERE i.mentor_id = #{mentorId} AND i.batch_id = #{batchId} AND i.status = 'WAITLISTED' ORDER BY IFNULL(i.waitlist_rank, 9999), i.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_intent (application_id, batch_id, student_id, mentor_id, sort_no, status, waitlist_rank, comment) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{batchId}, #{studentId}, #{mentorId}, #{sortNo}, #{status}, #{waitlistRank}, #{comment})
mapper.update: UPDATE application_intent SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE application_intent SET waitlist_rank = #{waitlistRank} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE application_intent SET status = #{status} WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application_intent WHERE mentor_id = #{mentorId} AND batch_id = #{batchId} AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application_intent WHERE mentor_id = #{mentorId} AND batch_id = #{batchId} AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application_intent WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
